note: The script asks for the hook text, one name super, a number pop, a key-word line and a word stack, so 5 graphics and the end card. Dave Smith's name and the million figure stay off screen until Brit confirms them.

mg.title: Hook text
mg.cue: Hook text on frame 1, top: “Kiva in schools”
mg.use: Start the clip at frame 0045 (fully on) and hold it until 00:03. Top third. Nothing else on screen with it.

mg.title: Name super
mg.cue: Name super at 00:05–00:08, small, lower left above the captions: “Vishal Ghotge” / CEO at Kiva
mg.use: Put it on at 00:05 for 3 s. Move it lower left, above the captions. Type the second line <CEO at Kiva> under it.

mg.title: 10 years
mg.cue: Number pop, top third, as he says it: “10 years”
mg.use: Put it on as he says “10 years” and hold 3 s, in the top band. Keep captions on.

mg.title: Key words
mg.cue: Key words, top third, as he says them: “teach a course using Kiva”
mg.use: Put it on as he says these words and hold about 3 s, in the top band. Keep captions on.

mg.title: Empathy list
mg.cue: Key words one at a time, top third, as he says them: “build empathy” / “fundraise” / “halfway across the world”
mg.use: Start it on “build empathy”. Each line lands on his word. Top band. Keep captions on.

mg.title: End card
mg.cue: End card on dark forest green #223829: Kiva logo, then “Give a little. Change a lot.” and kiva.org.
mg.src: Kiva's white wordmark from the Kiva brand kit built from kiva.org (Mac Studio, state/kiva/brand/logos, 10 Oct 2026), endcards/index.json. Tagline from the client file.
